name: @rei/cedar-token-video
description: A narrated Remotion introduction to Cedar semantic colors and component migration

scripts.assets: npm run build:data && npm run fonts && npm run audio
scripts.dev: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts CedarSemanticTokens out/cedar-semantic-tokens-v2.mp4 && node scripts/finalize-narration.mjs out/cedar-semantic-tokens-v2.mp4
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts CedarSemanticTokens out/cedar-semantic-tokens-v2.png --frame=100
scripts.compositions: npm run assets && remotion compositions src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:data && npm run audio && tsc --noEmit
